title: [Payables Agent] set Document Date and Due Date on Incomming Document when Draft is created
summary: The Prepare draft step for inbound E-Documents now copies Document Date and Due Date from the E-Document Purchase Header, ensuring these dates appear correctly on the Inbound E-Documents list once the document reaches Draft ready status.
key_points: Document Date and Due Date are now populated from E-Document Purchase Header during draft preparation
Values are only copied when present, preventing blank dates from overwriting existing data
Matches the existing approach used for vendor name and number population
Low-risk change affecting only the Prepare draft processing step
quote: This fix copies the Document Date and Due Date from the E-Document Purchase Header onto the E-Document during the Prepare draft step.
